item.title: How shofars became the spiritual soundtrack of Rosh Hashanah
item.description: Rosh Hashanah, the Jewish New Year, begins at sunset Friday. For many Jews around the world, a highlight of the holiday will be hearing the shofar: an animal's horn blown like a trumpet.

item.title: As diseases loom, CDC's response to measles deaths stirs fears about agency's reliability

item.title: They cleaned up ground zero. Now many are hiding from ICE
item.description: After 9/11, thousands of rescue and cleanup crews went to work at ground zero. They were exposed to toxic debris and experienced psychological trauma. Today, many say they live in fear of deportation.
